title: [Main]-Incident 51000001968459: Issue while creating any import purchase invoice
summary: Fixed cost-loading logic for import purchase invoices with Nil-Rated GST and Non-Availment setting to properly include Custom Duty in inventory and direct cost entries.
key_points: Custom Duty is now included in inventory cost for import invoices with Nil-Rated GST and Non-Availment
Logic no longer exits prematurely when GST amount is zero if Custom Duty is present
Non-Availment cost-loading is restricted to prevent duplicate Custom Duty capitalization in Availment scenarios
Resolves issue where Custom Duty was missing from Inventory and Direct Cost Applied entries
quote: Custom Duty was not included in Inventory and Direct Cost Applied entries.
